help.title: Advanced search help
help.text: Advanced search can be used to create more complex search queries. Start by selecting a search category. Search category determines, what you want your query to look for. Some categories (like searching in case data) require further configuration. Afterwards you have to select a search operator. The operator determines how the query attempts to match your data. Are you looking for numbers from a specific range? Are you looking for an exact match? Finally you have to enter the searched value. You can combine simpler queries into more complicated ones by binding them with an OR or an AND keyword. Queries combined with OR find results that match at least one sub-query. Queries combined with AND find results that match all sub-queries.

ifElseStatement.label: If/Else Statement
ifElseStatement.description: The general working of this statement is that first a condition is evaluated in the if statement. If the condition is true it then executes the statements thereafter and stops before the else condition and exits out of the loop. If the condition is false it then executes the statements in the else statement block and then exits the loop.

nestedIfStatement.label: Nested If Statement
nestedIfStatement.description: The general working of this statement is that first a condition is evaluatedin the if statement. If the condition is true it then executes the statements thereafter and stops before the else condition and exits out of the loop. Ifthe condition is false it then executes the statements in the else if statementsand finally in else block and then exits the loop.

switchStatement.label: Switch Statement
switchStatement.description: Nested if-else statement is so common and is used so often that an easier statement was designed called the switch statement.

whileStatement.label: While Statement
whileStatement.description: The while statement is executed by first evaluating the condition expression (a Boolean value), and if the result is true, then the statements in the while loop are executed. The process is repeated starting from the evaluation of the condition in the while statement. This loop continues until the condition evaluates to false. When the condition becomes false, the loop terminates

forInStatement.label: For-in statement
forInStatement.description: The for-in statement is used to iterate through a set of values.

changeValue.label: Change value
changeValue.description: Sets new value to data field f returned by calculation closure. If the returned value is null, fields value is set to default value. If the returned value is unchanged, fields value is unchanged and actions with a trigger set on given field are not triggered.

changeChoices.label: Change choices
changeChoices.description: Sets a new set of choices to data field f.

changeOptions.label: Change options
changeOptions.description: Sets a new map of options to data field f.

changeAllowedNets.label: Change allowed nets
changeAllowedNets.description: Sets a new map of options to data field f.

changeBehaviour.label: Change behaviour
changeBehaviour.description: Changes behaviour of given data field f on transition t, if condition returns true

changeMultipleBehaviour.label: Change multiple behaviour
changeMultipleBehaviour.description: Changes behaviour of given data fields f on tasks t, if condition returns true. Tasks can be referenced by list of transition references, list of task ids or list of task references

setDataByTransition.label: Set data fields by transition
setDataByTransition.description: Sets values of data fields on task of transition in current case. Values are mapped to data fields in dataSet using data fields import Id as key.

setDataByTask.label: Set data fields by task
setDataByTask.description: Sets values of data fields on task. Values are mapped to data fields in dataSet using data fields import Id as key.

setDataByTransitionId.label: Set data fields by transitionId
setDataByTransitionId.description: Sets values of data fields on task identified by transitionId of given case. Values are mapped to data fields in dataSet using data fields import Id as key.

setDataByTaskId.label: Set data fields by task
setDataByTaskId.description: Sets values of data fields on task identified by its Id. Values are mapped to data fields in dataSet using data fields import Id as key.

getDataByTransition.label: Get data fields by transition
getDataByTransition.description: Gets all data fields on the task of transition in the current case, mapped by its import Id.

getDataByTransitionId.label: Get data fields by transitionId
getDataByTransitionId.description: Gets all data fields on the task defined by its transitionId in given case, mapped by its import Id.

getDataByTask.label: Get data fields by transition
getDataByTask.description: Gets all data fields on the task, mapped by its import Id.

getDataByTaskId.label: Get data fields by transition
getDataByTaskId.description: Gets all data fields on the task of transition in the current case, mapped by its import Id.

createCaseByIdentifier.label: Create a new instance of process using process identifier
createCaseByIdentifier.description: Create a new instance of the newest version of process identified by the identifier. If the title, color, author, or locale is not specified then the default value will be used

createCaseByReference.label: Create a new instance of process using process reference
createCaseByReference.description: Create a new instance of given process. If the title, color, author, or locale is not specified then the default value will be used

changeCaseProperty.label: Change the property of the case
changeCaseProperty.description: Changes the property of the current case, the new value is generated by the supplier.

getTaskId.label: Get task Id by transitionId
getTaskId.description: Returns the task Id if task with given tranisitionId exists in case

assignTaskByTransitionId.label: Assign Task by transitionId
assignTaskByTransitionId.description: Assign the task with given transitionId of given case given user. If case or user is not specified the default value will be used.

assignTaskByTask.label: Assign Task by Task
assignTaskByTask.description: Assign the task to user. Optional parameter user identifies actor who will perform assign.

cancelTaskByTransitionId.label: Cancel Task by transitionId
cancelTaskByTransitionId.description: Cancels the task with given transitionId in a case.

cancelTaskByTask.label: Cancel Task by task
cancelTaskByTask.description: Cancels the provided task. Optional parameter user identifies actor who will perform cancel.

cancelTasks.label: Cancel Tasks
cancelTasks.description: Cancels all the provided tasks. Optional parameter user identifies actor who will perform cancel.

finishTaskByTransitionId.label: Finish Task by transitionId
finishTaskByTransitionId.description: Finish the task in current case with given transitionId. Optional parameter aCase identifies case which the task belongs to. Optional parameter user identifies actor who will perform cancel.

finishTaskByTask.label: Finish Task by task
finishTaskByTask.description: Finish the provided task. Optional parameter user identifies actor who will perform cancel.

finishTasksByList.label: Finish Tasks by list of tasks
finishTasksByList.description: Finish all the provided tasks. Optional parameter user identifies actor who will perform cancel.

executeTask.label: Execute task
executeTask.description: Executes task, which is found by its tranitionId. Task is found then assigned, then populated by data and in the end finished by system.

executeTransitions.label: Execute transitions
executeTransitions.description: Executes all fireable transitions identified by the transitionId in all case where the predicate returns true. For each task following actions are called: assign to the system user, save new data values, finish. The predicate is a list of Querydsl queries. Every case property can be used in a query. For more info see querydsl doc and QCase javadoc.

findCases.label: Find Cases
findCases.description: Finds all the cases that match the given predicate. The predicate is a groovy closure that accepts QCase object and returns QueryDSL Predicate.

findCasesPageable.label: Find Cases pageable
findCasesPageable.description: Finds all the cases that match the given predicate. The predicate is a groovy closure that accepts QCase object and returns QueryDSL Predicate. Pageable determines the requested page number, page size, sort fields, and sort direction.

findCase.label: Find Case
findCase.description: Finds the first case that matches the given predicate. The predicate is a groovy closure that accepts QCase object and returns QueryDSL Predicate.

findTasks.label: Find Tasks
findTasks.description: Finds all tasks that match the given predicate. The predicate is a groovy closure that accepts QCase object and returns QueryDSL Predicate.

findTasksWithPagination.label: Find Tasks with pagination
findTasksWithPagination.description: Finds all tasks that match the given predicate. The predicate is a groovy closure that accepts QCase object and returns QueryDSL Predicate.

findTask.label: Find Task
findTask.description: Finds the first task that matches the given predicate. The predicate is a groovy closure that accepts QCase object and returns QueryDSL Predicate.

findCaseElastic.label: Find case in Elasticsearch
findCaseElastic.description: Search elastic with string query for first occurrence.

countCasesElastic.label: Count cases in Elasticsearch
countCasesElastic.description: Gets the number of cases for a search query.

asyncRun.label: Async run with execution of task

assignRole.description: Assigns role identified by roleId to user. User is optional parameter, default value is currently logged user. Returns updated object of user.

assignRoleByImportIdAndIdentifier.label: Assign Role by import Id and process identifier
assignRoleByImportIdAndIdentifier.description: Assigns role identified by its import Id and netId to user. User is optional parameter, default value is currently logged user. Returns updated object of user.

assignRoleByImportIdAndProcess.label: Assign Role by import Id and process
assignRoleByImportIdAndProcess.description: Assigns role identified by its import Id and process reference to user. User is optional parameter, default value is currently logged user. Returns updated object of user.

assignRoleByImportIdIdentifierAndVersion.label: Assign Role by import Id, process identifier and version
assignRoleByImportIdIdentifierAndVersion.description: Assigns role identified by its import Id, process identifier, and version to user. User is optional parameter, default value is currently logged user. Returns updated object of user.

removeRole.label: Remove Role
removeRole.description: Removes role identified by roleId to user. User is optional parameter, default value is currently logged user. Returns updated object of user.

removeRoleByImportIdAndIdentifier.label: Remove Role by import Id and process identifier
removeRoleByImportIdAndIdentifier.description: Removes role identified by its import Id and netId to user. User is optional parameter, default value is currently logged user. Returns updated object of user.

removeRoleByImportIdAndProcess.label: Remove Role by import Id and process
removeRoleByImportIdAndProcess.description: Removes role identified by its import Id and process reference to user. User is optional parameter, default value is currently logged user. Returns updated object of user.

removeRoleByImportIdIdentifierAndVersion.label: Remove Role by import Id, process identifier and version
removeRoleByImportIdIdentifierAndVersion.description: Removes role identified by its import Id, process identifier, and version to user. User is optional parameter, default value is currently logged user. Returns updated object of user.

findByEmail.description: Returns user with the specified email or null if no user with the email exists.

findById.label: Find by Id
findById.description: Returns user with the specified id or throws IllegalArgumentException if no user with the id exists.

deleteUserByEmail.label: Delete user by email
deleteUserByEmail.description: Deletes user by email. All tasks assigned to this user will be canceled and cases created by this user will be anonymized.

deleteUserByRef.label: Delete user by reference
deleteUserByRef.description: Deletes user by reference. All tasks assigned to this user will be canceled and cases created by this user will be anonymized.

redirectToRoute.label: Redirect to route
redirectToRoute.description: Redirects user to the given route. Route must be known path of the web application, external URLs will be ignored.

generatePdfWithLocale.label: Generate PDF
generatePdfWithLocale.description: Generates PDF from transition by <transitionId> (transition has to be executable) and saves it to file field by <fieldId>. I18n strings are translated using the given locale.

generatePdfWithZoneId.label: Generate PDF
generatePdfWithZoneId.description: Generates PDF from transition by <transitionId> (transition has to be executable) and saves it to file field by <fieldId>. Date and date time fields are formatted with the given ZoneId.
